_comment: Lab stand-in for DNS. In production: socket.gethostbyaddr(ip)[0] (PTR) and socket.gethostbyname_ex(name)[2] (forward). Keys are addresses/names inside pools that already exist in data/world.json; nothing here is a real record. Addresses with no PTR (carrier NAT, most residential lines, most cloud VMs) are simply absent. 203.0.113.121 has a PTR that CLAIMS googlebot.com but whose forward lookup does not come back to it: it passes a PTR-only check and fails forward confirmation.
